name: Aviary Tax AMM
description: Constant-product markets that take a buy and a sell tax in one chosen mint, the tax side, whichever way a trade goes. Every tax is capped by a limit compiled into the program, and can only move inside a range fixed at creation, by an optional tax authority that can also renounce. Liquidity is seeded once and locked for good. The tax is booked in the market's vault and paid out to the market's tax recipients and burn, after the suite share.

init.description: Creates a tax market for two tokens. The market state is a new keypair, which signs. Add the router's init_fee_account for each mint and the seed action in the same transaction, so the market opens as it is created.

args.name: tax_side
args.label: Tax side
args.description: The mint index, 0 or 1, every tax is taken in, whichever way a trade goes. Fixed for the market's life.

args.name: buy_tax_bps
args.label: Buy tax (basis points)
args.description: Taken from the input when the tax side is sold into the market. Inside its range.

args.name: sell_tax_bps
args.label: Sell tax (basis points)
args.description: Taken from the output when the tax side is bought from the market. Inside its range.

args.name: buy_tax_min_bps
args.label: Lowest buy tax (basis points)
args.description: The buy tax can never go below this. Fixed for the market's life.

args.name: buy_tax_max_bps
args.label: Highest buy tax (basis points)
args.description: The buy tax can never go above this, and never above the program's cap. Fixed for the market's life.

args.name: sell_tax_min_bps
args.label: Lowest sell tax (basis points)
args.description: The sell tax can never go below this. Fixed for the market's life.

args.name: sell_tax_max_bps
args.label: Highest sell tax (basis points)
args.description: The sell tax can never go above this, and never above the program's cap. Fixed for the market's life.

args.name: tax_authority
args.label: Tax authority
args.description: May change the taxes inside their ranges and the tax recipients, or renounce. The default (all-zero) key means none, so nothing can ever change.

args.name: seeder
args.label: Seeder
args.description: The only wallet that can seed the market's liquidity, once.

args.name: recipient_0
args.label: Tax recipient 1
args.description: A wallet paid its share of the creator's part of the tax. Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key.

args.name: recipient_1
args.label: Tax recipient 2
args.description: Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key.

args.name: recipient_2
args.label: Tax recipient 3
args.description: Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key.

args.name: recipient_3
args.label: Tax recipient 4
args.description: Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key.

args.name: share_0
args.label: Tax recipient 1's share (basis points)
args.description: Of the creator's part, what is left after the suite share. Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one; the shares and the burn share sum to 10,000.

args.name: share_1
args.label: Tax recipient 2's share (basis points)
args.description: Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one.

args.name: share_2
args.label: Tax recipient 3's share (basis points)
args.description: Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one.

args.name: share_3
args.label: Tax recipient 4's share (basis points)
args.description: Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one.

args.name: burn_share_bps
args.label: Burn share (basis points)
args.description: Of the creator's part, burned. 0 when the tax side is native SOL.

args.name: virtual_side
args.label: Virtual side
args.description: The mint index, 0 or 1, whose reserve the virtual reserve adds to in pricing.

args.name: virtual_reserve
args.label: Virtual reserve
args.description: Added to the virtual side's real reserve in pricing, never paid out; 0 for none. Lets a token launch single-sided.

actions.name: seed
actions.label: Seed liquidity
actions.description: The market's seeder funds it, once, before any swap, and it opens for trading. The liquidity is locked for good: nothing can ever take it out. A side may be left empty only when its virtual reserve prices it.

actions.name: set_taxes
actions.label: Change the taxes
actions.description: The market's tax authority sets the buy and sell tax, each inside the range fixed at creation, which no tax can ever leave. The next swap pays the new rates; a trade quoted before the change is protected by its minimum output.

args.name: buy_tax_bps
args.label: Buy tax (basis points)
args.description: Taken from the input when the tax side is sold into the market. Inside its range.

args.name: sell_tax_bps
args.label: Sell tax (basis points)
args.description: Taken from the output when the tax side is bought from the market. Inside its range.

actions.name: set_recipients
actions.label: Change the tax recipients
actions.description: The market's tax authority replaces the tax recipients, their shares and the burn share, under the same rules as at creation. What each slot is already owed stays with the slot and goes to the wallet it names when paid out, so pay a leaving recipient out first.

args.name: recipient_0
args.label: Tax recipient 1
args.description: A wallet paid its share of the creator's part of the tax, and whatever its slot is already owed. Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key.

args.name: recipient_1
args.label: Tax recipient 2
args.description: Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key. A slot still owed tax can't be emptied.

args.name: recipient_2
args.label: Tax recipient 3
args.description: Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key. A slot still owed tax can't be emptied.

args.name: recipient_3
args.label: Tax recipient 4
args.description: Used slots first; an unused slot is the default (all-zero) key. A slot still owed tax can't be emptied.

args.name: share_0
args.label: Tax recipient 1's share (basis points)
args.description: Of the creator's part, what is left after the suite share. Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one; the shares and the burn share sum to 10,000.

args.name: share_1
args.label: Tax recipient 2's share (basis points)
args.description: Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one.

args.name: share_2
args.label: Tax recipient 3's share (basis points)
args.description: Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one.

args.name: share_3
args.label: Tax recipient 4's share (basis points)
args.description: Above 0 for a used slot, 0 for an unused one.

args.name: burn_share_bps
args.label: Burn share (basis points)
args.description: Of the creator's part, burned. 0 when the tax side is native SOL.

actions.name: renounce_tax_authority
actions.label: Renounce the tax authority
actions.description: The market's tax authority gives up its powers for good: the taxes and the tax recipients never change again.
